supported_completion_mechanism.mechanism: THE PROVIDER PROCESS RETURNING IS THE ONLY TRIGGER. After it returns the adapter measures the line delta, runs the task's own verification command (separately bounded at 30s), revalidates the measurement, chooses a disposition, COMMITS THE LINE WHATEVER THE DISPOSITION IS -- deliberately, because the manager freezes a checkpoint after every ending and its profile refuses a dirty worktree -- and publishes the proposal. baton_worker then measures the declared outputs and publish_completion writes /output/output.json LAST and ATOMICALLY, whose presence under its final name IS the completion signal.
